market_question: SCOTUS accepts sports event contract case by July 31, 2026?
reasoning: SCOTUS grants cert in less than 2% of petitions; a case explicitly about sports event contracts would need to be well advanced in the lower courts by early 2025 to meet the deadline, but no such case is publicly known. The timeline, combined with the narrow subject matter, makes a grant by July 2026 extremely unlikely.
evidence_points: SCOTUS accepts only ~60-70 cases per year out of ~7,000 petitions.
No prominent litigation over sports event contracts has reached the courts of appeals or petitioned for cert as of early 2025.
Even if a relevant suit were filed today, the typical path through district court, appeal, and cert petition would almost certainly exceed the remaining ~16 months.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of SCOTUS certiorari statistics and process
Awareness of recent event-contract litigation (election contracts, not sports)
Absence of known appellate case specifically addressing sports event contracts
